This sparked uproar and criticism among customers, who felt that the photo of Sheila was “derogatory” and “demeaning” to women. The incident has sparked a wider discussion about the role of women in the workplace and the importance of respecting their rights. It is hoped that this incident serves as a reminder to all organizations to be aware of the potential for such incidents to arise and to prevent them in the future.
